correctness.rationale: A concept (A,B) corresponds bijectively to a maximal independent set A union B in the bipartite complement, even when either side is empty, and m multiplies over components. For a fixed side-coloured tree with a+b=v vertices and colour-preserving automorphism group u, exact labelled component expectation is (n)_a(n)_b/u*(c/n)^(v-1)*(1-c/n)^(nv-ab-v+1); isolated left/right trees yield e^-c. Disjoint-embedding covariance is O(1/n), fixed type fluctuations O(n), so type counts/n converge L2. Every fixed cyclic component count is O(1) in expectation; a Poisson(d) with c<d<1 dominates binomial exploration for large n, providing exponential total-progeny tail and uniform large-component weighted bound <=2 log2 Ae^-eta K. Thus fixed-K L1 convergence passes to full series, establishing absolute convergence and L1/probability without mistaking expected C for log C. For v=2,3,4, side-coloured tree types give c e^-2c log2 + c²e^-3c log2 + c³e^-4c(log3+log2/3); expansion matches displayed cubic. Rooted (selected,already dominated,needs parent) DP m(T)=A+B is correct.
